text:
kai (recruiter): Quick coordination: Candidate Omar Diaz (Data Eng) arriving intercity same day. Requests: visa support letter for ESTA clarification, a rideshare stipend from airport, and a quiet corner for his coding task. Prefer start around 11:00am local. Can ops handle?

maria (hiring mgr): 11:00 remote code challenge + 13:00 onsite pair session is fine. We can keep the in-person part to 90m so he can catch a 16:00 train.

jess (people-ops): We can provide a travel stipend and a brief letter explaining interview purpose. @logistics-bot can you reserve a visitor parking spot and confirm a quiet room?

logistics-bot: Visitor spot V11 reserved 11:30-15:30. Conf A (quiet) reserved 12:45-15:00. Will pre-print badge. Please supply candidate phone and ID name.

it-support-bot: Loaner Windows laptop available if needed. Also can provide an external keyboard and mouse. ETA 24h for imaging.

kai (recruiter): Omar details: Omar Diaz, phone 628-555-0168, will bring his own device but appreciate charger+power strip. ETA to office ~12:20 if traffic good. Sending calendar invites with note about train at 16:00.

jess (people-ops): Stipend: $40 rideshare voucher issued, and visa letter draft at https://redwood-internal/hr/letters/omar-diaz (internal). Adding expense instructions to invite.

maria (hiring mgr): Two asks: 1) Add "candidate needs to leave by 15:30 to catch train" in the invite. 2) Zoom fallback link and disable recording.

front-desk: Noted. We'll give Omar the badge and a "quiet room" sign. Reception to hold loaner if requested.

kai (recruiter): Candidate confirmed and said he'll bring passport copy. All invites sent for 2026-07-08 11:00-11:40 (remote) + 12:30-14:00 (onsite Conf A). Thanks team!

jess (people-ops): Closing logistics. Reopen if travel changes.
